title: Pizza Napoletana
subtitle: Neapolitan pizza with anchovies, olives and capers
excerpt: The original anchovy pizza -- bold, salty and deeply savoury. Anchovies, black olives and capers sit on a base of crushed tomato with no mozzarella to distract. Buffalo mozzarella can be added if you prefer, but the classic version is dressed with just olive oil.
sourceNotes: Pizza Napoletana (not to be confused with 'Neapolitan style' pizza) is one of the original named Neapolitan pizzas. It is defined by anchovies, capers and olives on a tomato base.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze the dough balls after proving. Defrost overnight in the fridge.
recipe.batchNotes: Double the dough batch and freeze half.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make the dough up to 24 hours ahead and prove in the fridge overnight.
recipe.temperatureNote: As hot as your oven will go. Preheat the baking sheet or stone for at least 45 minutes.

content.text: Drain the capers and pat the anchovies dry. Wet toppings release steam and make the base soggy. The tomato sauce should be well-seasoned and not too wet.

items.prepNote: from a tin, drained and patted dry

content.text: Make the dough: dissolve the yeast in 325ml warm water. Mix with the flour, salt and oil. Knead for 8 to 10 minutes until smooth. Divide into 2 balls. Prove for 1 hour or overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 250C. Put a heavy baking sheet on the top shelf. Heat for at least 45 minutes.
Season the drained tomatoes with a pinch of salt and a little oregano. Stretch each dough ball thin on a floured surface.
Spread the tomato sauce over each base. Arrange the anchovies, olives and capers over the top. Add mozzarella if using. Drizzle with olive oil.
Slide onto the hot baking sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the crust is charred at the edges and the topping is sizzling.
Serve immediately. A final drizzle of olive oil over the hot pizza is good.

items.cause: Too much wet topping or baking sheet not hot enough
items.fix: Drain tomatoes well. Pat anchovies and capers dry. Preheat the baking sheet for the full 45 minutes.

items.cause: Too many used, or oil-packed variety not rinsed
items.fix: Use 4 to 5 fillets per pizza rather than 6. If using salt-packed anchovies, rinse them thoroughly first.

content.text: Pizza Napoletana is one of the named traditional pizzas of Naples. It is a direct ancestor of all modern pizza. The anchovy version is older than the cheese version. Oregano is more traditional here than basil.
